Hull parents know the drill — horizontal rain off the Humber and a three-year-old who's already lapped the living room twice. Soft play in Hull isn't a luxury, it's survival. Hull's indoor play scene suits all ages and budgets. You'll find everything from calm, toddler-only venues with padded floors and sensory corners to multi-level adventure frames with ball cannons, rope bridges, and zip lines for older children. Most venues also have on-site cafes — the quality of the coffee varies wildly, so it's worth checking before you commit to a long session. The better venues separate age groups into distinct zones, which makes a real difference if you're bringing a crawling baby alongside an older sibling.

Prices for soft play in Hull are good value compared to cities like Leeds or Sheffield, typically ranging from £4 to £9 per child for a standard session. Under-1s are free at most venues. Off-peak weekday sessions are noticeably cheaper and quieter — Tuesday to Thursday mornings between 9am and 11am are the sweet spot for anyone wanting a calmer experience. Weekend slots fill fast, so book online in advance where possible. Most larger Hull venues now run timed sessions rather than open-ended play, so check before you arrive.

If you need [SEN-friendly soft play in Hull](/soft-play/hull/sen-friendly), several venues run dedicated quiet sessions with reduced lighting, no music, and capped numbers. These book up quickly — following venues on social media is the best way to catch availability. For [birthday parties in Hull](/soft-play/hull/birthday-parties), the larger venues around Kingswood and east Hull offer full packages from around £120 upwards, including a dedicated host and party room. Book at least six weeks ahead for a Saturday slot — they go fast.

Hull's soft play venues are spread across the city, so there's usually something within easy reach wherever you're based — from Anlaby and Hessle in the west to Holderness Road in the east, and north into Bransholme and Kingswood. Families in the East Riding can also find options nearby in [Beverley](/soft-play/beverley) and [Bridlington](/soft-play/bridlington). Our directory covers the wider area so you can find indoor play near Hull wherever you are in East Yorkshire.
